## Revised-vs-baseline notes (v1.5.0 round)

The v1.5.0 round is an *invariant* round, not a feature round: zero feature
units were added or removed (superset discipline — every unit count above is
the v1.4.10 count plus the B.1 proof scaffolding). The scripts touched by the
round, with what changed:

| Script | v1.5.0 change |
|---|---|
| Akasha Silence | IG CTA popup poll: attempt ceiling (B.1) |
| Images++ | progress watcher: idle-park + re-arm (B.1) |
| Media Player Controller | discovery / ad-skip / UI-cadence / persistence intervals: idle-park + media-event re-arm ×4 (B.1); psiMedia* load-guard marks ledgered (B.1 globals) |
| m3u8++ | media sweep: idle-park + media-event re-arm (B.1); dev-proxy fetch wrap ledgered (globals) |
| Instagram++ | injection daemon: attempt ceiling; stat updater: idle-park + click/visibility re-arm (B.1) |
| Maximize Any Media | PiP redraw timer: dead-viewer self-clear (B.1) |
| Prompt Master | flow-credit poll + storage sweep: idle-park + observer/visibility re-arm (B.1); __mpSortMode / __apCustomShortcutsMap / clearAllCustomTooltips closure-ized; debug hooks ledgered (B.1 globals) |
| YouTube Playlist Master | random-apply poll: route-re-arm idle-park; reverse-order failsafe: BUS-reset re-arm idle-park; sweep coalescer: idle-empty (B.1 caches + polling) |
| Forums++ | isFF / logs closure-ized (B.1 globals) |
| Youtube Removed Video Revealer | ArchivedIDS family closure-ized (B.1 globals) |
| Watermark++ | image session store: FIFO cap 16 (B.1 caches) |
| LinkMasterΨ / Blob2URL / Bunkr++ / Recon / 4ndr0purge / Confirmation Bypass / Login Form Autofiller | ledger adjudications only (marks/registries proven by design arguments, expiry v1.6.0) |

Every row's evidence: `npm run check` census lines + the negative-proof
transcripts (scripts/negative-proof-*.txt in the round's evidence bundle).
